guard.behavior_on_drift: fail closed; no automatic writes, restarts, or replay
checks: refuse absent, symlink or non-regular targets

live_vps_readonly_verification.operation: REA 6.8.0 native capture_process_scenario, root-owned file checks

regression.initial_failure_reason: FileIO on a directory raised IsADirectoryError before fstat; changed guard to fstat opened fd before reading

recovery.policy: After a rebuild, stop and inspect version and original/compiled hashes. Restore only recognized original binaries using both original SHA-guarded recovery scripts, verify backups, execute process capture and MCP real smoke. Restart only the existing service if deployed compiled code changed; never auto-mutate from a transport invocation.

limitations: This guard is executed by the existing GitHub Actions → SSH transport. Direct MCP clients or out-of-band service restarts are not covered by this particular gate.
This guard detects runtime drift; it does not prevent a build from changing files, and intentionally does not attempt automatic recovery.
Private backups are root-only and were verified via the native REA root-level observation, not by the SSH ubuntu transport guard.
The corrected compiled modules remain version 6.8.0-specific; any legitimate future version upgrade requires revisiting compatibility and hashes.
